definitions.name: L2C.SUM
definitions.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for an empty Vector).

definitions.name: L2C.MEAN
definitions.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV L2C.SUM ZV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

definitions.name: L2C.VAR
definitions.body: 'ZS' BIND ZS L2C.MEAN 'ZM' BIND ZS ZM SUB 'ZD' BIND ZD ZD MUL L2C.MEAN
definitions.note: Population variance of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

definitions.name: L2C.MED
definitions.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV SORT 'ZS' BIND ZV LENGTH 'ZN' BIND ZS ZN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET ZS ZN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when even).

definitions.name: L2C.JOINSP
definitions.note: Joins a Vector of texts with single spaces.

definitions.name: L2C.CAP
definitions.body: 'ZW' BIND ZW CHARS 0 GET UPPER ZW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Upper-cases the first character of a text and leaves the rest unchanged.

definitions.name: L2C.DIVS
definitions.body: 'ZN' BIND 1 ZN RANGE [ 'ZD' BIND ZN ZD DIV FLOOR ZD MUL ZN EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Ascending positive divisors of a positive integer N.

definitions.name: L2C.SUMBY
definitions.body: GROUP 'ZR' BIND ZR KEYS ZR VALUES [ L2C.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Keys Vector and values Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: L2C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'ZL' BIND ZL [ 0 GET ] MAP ZL [ 1 GET ] MAP L2C.SUMBY
definitions.note: Ledger entries to a Record from each name to the sum of its amounts.

definitions.name: L2C.QTYSKU
definitions.body: 'ZO' BIND ZO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP ZO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP L2C.SUMBY
definitions.note: Orders Vector to a Record from each sku to the sum of its qty.

definitions.name: L2C.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON text with an orders key to the Vector of order Records.

definitions.name: L2C.REV
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'ORD' BIND ORD 'qty' GET ORD 'price' GET MUL ] MAP L2C.SUM
definitions.note: Total of qty times price over the orders that have a price.

definitions.name: L2C.TAGS
definitions.body: [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET ] MAP [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: Orders Vector to a Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it.
